basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old software developer based in Atlanta with a passion for anime and craft beer. On weekdays, I'm usually online in the evenings, often diving into discussions about One Piece or the latest developments in the world of strategy games. During weekends, I enjoy exploring local breweries with friends. I'm single, and when I'm not coding or watching anime, I spend my time reading manga or playing Hearthstone. I dislike overly dramatic anime fillers and prefer the concise storytelling found in manga.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been a self-taught enthusiast of Japanese culture since high school. My expertise in anime and manga comes from years of following various series and participating in online communities. Additionally, my knowledge of craft beer has expanded through regular visits to local breweries and engaging with the beer-loving community in Atlanta.
